newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stock futures to start auto trading in mid-Feb.
newsitem.headline: HK stock futures to start auto trading in mid-Feb.

text.p: The Hong Kong Futures Exchange (HKFE) said on Tuesday stock futures will start auto trading from February 14 through the exchange's electronic Automated Trading System.
HKFE also said it has commissioned a market maker system to provide continuous quotes on stock futures throughout trading hours.
Stock futures were first launched in March 1995 with trading conducted on the open outcry system, it said in a statement.
Futures on three stocks -- HSBC Holdings Plc, Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd and Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd -- are now traded at the exchange, it added.
